rate_table_note: Rates are the actual premium rates in Table 1200-2, Ins 1201.18, for credit accident and health single premium 14-day retroactive coverage, per $100 for credit transactions of 12 months in duration, by class of business. They equal the nominal rates of Ins 1201.09 times the actual premium rate factor for credit A&H (.618, .759, 1.014, .509, .494), which applies to all plans (other plans and terms not recorded).
source_title: N.H. Admin. R. Ins 1200, Credit Life and Credit Accident and Health Insurance (General Court rules site; Ins 1201.18 Table 1200-2; ss by #12474, eff 2-2-18)
summary: Rates in force: New Hampshire's actual premium rates for credit accident and health in Table 1200-2 (Ins 1201.18): 12-month single premium 14-day retroactive rates of $0.967 to $1.987 per $100, by class of business. The table took its current form with the readoption effective February 2, 2018 (#12474); whether that readoption changed the rates was not checked, so February 2, 2018 is the date the current table took effect.
